info.title: Lending analyst
info.description: Internal agent's tools: read decisions, the portfolio and what-if scenarios, and propose changes. It has no approve, reject or activate action. Every call runs as the signed-in person.

get.description: Use when asked whether a customer is offered or held, or why. Returns the action, the reason in plain words, and the values compared.
Use for offers and holds, reasons, capital used, budget, capital left, the capital price, and current parameter values. Capital used is a simulated estimate.
Use to compare the effect of a different budget, step or fee on offers, capital, NPV and defaults. Results are precomputed simulated estimates for specific values only.
Use to see sets waiting for review or in force, and the status of a proposal.

403.description: The caller may not see parameter sets

post.description: Creates a proposed set from the active one with a new budget, step or fee. Only call after the person has confirmed the exact change in this conversation. It does not approve or activate anything.

note.description: Why this change is proposed, in the person's words.

budget.description: New risk-weighted capital budget in USD.

step.description: Each increase as a share of the initial loan, for example 0.15.

fee.description: Fee per accepted increase in USD.

409.description: Refused by the database, with its reason

422.description: Not a change this endpoint accepts
